summary.claim_boundary: Local CASP17 historical seed-clearance action bundle only. It materializes open seed-clearance phases into per-seed request folders for operator work. Request files are templates and are intentionally not no-leak evidence. It does not fill operator clearance, certify chronology, fetch native structures, score native accuracy, mutate competitive-floor identity intake, run predictors, or submit to CASP.
